name: Web 2.0 Gloss
summary: Glossy rounded buttons, vertical gradients, reflections under logos, big friendly type, star badges and a 'beta' tag on a clean white page. Social and tool start-ups used it after 2004.

philosophy.core_thesis: A site is a friendly tool: make every control look glossy, round and easy to press.
design_principles: Fill buttons with a vertical 2-stop gradient, for example #5B9BD5 to #2F6DB5, with a white 1px inner highlight at the top.
Set a gloss on the top half: a white overlay at 35% to 50% opacity that ends at 50% of the button height.
Round corners at 6px to 12px on buttons and cards, and use pill shapes for tags.
Place a reflection under the logo: a flipped copy at 30% opacity that fades to 0% over 40px.
Set big, rounded headlines at 36px to 48px in a friendly sans, and 14px body text on a white ground.
Add a star or burst badge of 60px to 90px with 'beta', 'new' or 'free' in bold white on orange (#FF8A00).
Use a soft drop shadow of 0 2px 4px at 20% black under cards and a 1px light grey line (#D0D7DE).
anti_patterns: Thin light type with no emphasis

layout.grid_mechanics: A centred container of 960px on a 12-column grid with 20px gutters; a hero of 500px to 600px with a big call-to-action.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 30% to 40% of the page is empty; the spacing scale is 10, 20 and 40px.
layout.alignment_rules: Centred hero and logo; text blocks flush left; feature rows in 3 columns with icons.
layout.container_geometry: Cards and buttons with a 8px radius, pill tags, round avatars and badges.

font_pairings.note: Varela Round is the open look-alike of the rounded display faces of the time; Nunito carries the text.
A soft geometric display with a neutral text face.
A rounder, bolder display for badges and logos.

hierarchy_rules: Use 14px for body text, 18px for lead text and 40px for the hero title.
Use bold and a darker blue for headings.
Use a link colour of blue with no underline until hover.
Use sentence case in all text, with a lower-case brand name.

color.palette_structure: A white ground, one strong blue, one fresh green, one orange accent and pale grey lines.
color.contrast_rules: Navy ink on white is 14:1; white on web blue is 5.3:1; white on orange is for badges of 14px bold and above.
color.surface_treatment: Vertical 2-stop gradients on buttons and bars; flat white and pale blue grounds; a gloss overlay on controls.
color.light_and_shadow: Light comes from above: a 1px white highlight on top edges, a soft 0 2px 4px shadow below and a reflection under logos.

materiality.surface_simulation: Glossy plastic and glass buttons on a clean page: a candy surface.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px line in a darker tone of the fill; a 1px inner white highlight.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: A shadow of 0 2px 4px at 20% black; no backdrop blur.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Glossy 32px to 48px icons in a rounded square with a gradient and a small highlight; round badges and stars.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Reflected logos, starbursts, pill tags, speech bubbles, a big hero screenshot with a reflection and cartoon mascots.

motion.transition_physics: Menus and panels fade and slide at 200ms to 300ms with ease-out; Ajax updates highlight in yellow (#FFF6A5) for 1s and fade out.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover brightens the gradient by 8% and lifts the button by 1px; active state inverts the gradient and removes the shadow.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels that the tool is friendly, new and easy to trust.

use_cases: parody of the first social web
avoid_when: The brand needs a flat, modern or serious tone.
The device needs a light, fast render with few images.
The audience needs a premium, restrained look.

modifiers.how: Remove the gradients, the gloss and the shadows; keep the colour and the round corners.
Add textures and material detail: leather, stitching and glass.
Add a sky ground, bubbles and green nature photos.

pack.why: Rounded filled icons with two tones match the glossy tiles of the first social web.

ground.why: The ground is a pale sky gradient above a white page, as in a start-up landing page.
